entities.summary: "My Way" is a song by American nu metal band Limp Bizkit from their third studio album, Chocolate Starfish and the Hot Dog Flavored Water (2000). It was the fourth single released from the album. The song is also known for being the main theme song for the then-World Wrestling Federation pay-per-view WrestleMania X-Seven.
